description: Cross-kingdom distribution of Fis1, Mdv1/Caf4 and metazoan fission-receptor domains, with C. elegans presence
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
U="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/"
# live check: do the C. elegans mff genes carry the metazoan MFF domain?
for acc in ["Q19343","P91344"]:
    j=requests.get(U+acc+".json",timeout=60).json()
    g=",".join(x.get("geneName",{}).get("value","") for x in j.get("genes",[]))
    pf=[x["id"] for x in j["uniProtKBCrossReferences"] if x["database"]=="Pfam"]
    tm=[f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]] if (f:=next((f for f in j.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane"),None)) else None
    print(acc,g,"len",j["sequence"]["length"],"Pfam",pf,"TM",tm)

# counts verified by the UniProt REST x-total-results header in the previous cell
rows=[
 ("Mdv1 Fis1-binding\ndomain (PF11542)",15,0,0,0,15),
 ("Caf4 Fis1-binding\ndomain (PF11615)",17,0,0,0,16),
 ("Fis1 TPR-like\n(PF14852)",3667,2,80,1133,1483),
 ("Fis1 N-arm\n(PF14853)",4140,2,141,1337,1500),
 ("MFF (PF05644)",3351,1,83,3351,0),
 ("MiD49/51 NTase\n(PF20266)",13436,1,108,13433,0),
 ("MiD49/51-specific\n(PF21297)",1742,0,0,1742,0),
]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["domain","total","C. elegans","Nematoda","Metazoa","Fungi"])
print(df.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2))
y=np.arange(len(df))[::-1]
w=0.38
ax[0].barh(y+w/2,df["Metazoa"].clip(lower=0.5),height=w,color="#2c6fbb",label="Metazoa (33208)")
ax[0].barh(y-w/2,df["Fungi"].clip(lower=0.5),height=w,color="#c0702a",label="Fungi (4751)")
ax[0].set_xscale("log");ax[0].set_xlim(0.5,3e4)
ax[0].set_yticks(y);ax[0].set_yticklabels(df["domain"],fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel("UniProtKB entries with the domain (log scale)")
ax[0].set_title("A  Fission-machinery domains by kingdom",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
for yy,m,f in zip(y,df["Metazoa"],df["Fungi"]):
    ax[0].text(0.55,yy+w/2,f" {m}",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
    ax[0].text(0.55,yy-w/2,f" {f}",va="center",fontsize=7.5)

ax[1].barh(y,df["C. elegans"],height=0.55,color=["#b03030" if v==0 else "#2e7d32" for v in df["C. elegans"]])
ax[1].set_yticks(y);ax[1].set_yticklabels(df["domain"],fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("C. elegans (taxid 6239) entries")
ax[1].set_xlim(0,2.6)
ax[1].set_title("B  Present or absent in C. elegans",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for yy,v,n in zip(y,df["C. elegans"],df["Nematoda"]):
    ax[1].text(v+0.06,yy,f"{v}   (Nematoda {n})",va="center",fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle("The Fis1 fold is pan-eukaryotic; its yeast adaptors Mdv1 and Caf4 are fungal-only.\nC. elegans carries the metazoan receptor MFF (mff-1, mff-2) instead.",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
